## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `31b3ea032b4d8af8b8b14ea3cafbacc678431d14`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + none (no file in the diff implements it; `.changeset/34228-print-section-per-block.md` and `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` are prose faces, read against the same code)
Security-touching: yes

First record on this PR. Inputs: card #34228 with every comment (ruling 6922479414, letter C), the PR body and comments, the net diff against merge-base, the head's check-runs. Read on `main`, not reviewed: `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-print.ts` and `page.tsx`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change: three prose files, no schema, code or test. Right.
- `avoidBreakInside` gloss "keep each block whole on one sheet when it fits" is the describe's own clause, word for word (`page.zod.ts`, `print.avoidBreakInside`). Right.
- "a multi-section block moves to the next sheet whole" follows from the reader: `buildPagePrintStylesheet` emits `[data-print-page] [data-region] > * { break-inside: avoid; }` and nothing finer, so a region's block is the unit. `break-inside: avoid` is a hint, so a block taller than a sheet still splits; "when it fits" is true, and the changeset says so. Right.
- Matches ruling C step 4 and promises nothing more: meaning unchanged, one `record:details` per section, showcase invoice untouched.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch is right: `skills/**` ships in `packages/skills` and only wording moves; `content/docs/**` is in no package. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right, on both the PR body and the changeset: no key, value, default or refusal changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6924120395: `open_questions` empty, no security finding; its one out-of-scope note is carried by #34427. Nothing to escalate.
- L1-b notes (6924649735) are both closed on this head: the changeset names the dropped ", in full"; the gloss carries "when it fits".
- Check-runs on the head: every run success or skipped, none red, both `Check Changeset` runs green.
- Token ceiling: `pages.md` is 22662 bytes, 5666 tokens; the row stays 5669 and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not in the diff.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.
- PR author is the fleet bot; no relay note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`, old against new, sentence by sentence. Dropped propositions, all of them:

1. "Validated today" — still stated: the parse refuses `print` on the wrong page, and `os validate` / `os build` and the save door refuse an unprintable block.
2. "the console's print rendering that applies it follows" — false on `main`: `PageRenderer` mounts the sheet `buildPagePrintStylesheet` builds, and the ledger row `print` and its children are `live`. Dropping it is right.
3. "`os validate` warns the layout is not yet applied" — false on `main`: the ledger note records `authorWarn` dropped when the row went live, and no such text remains under `packages/lint/src`. Dropping it is right. No other doc or skill carried the stale claim.
4. ", in full" — no rule lost: "all it declares … the same at any width" stays, and the "draws a window of its rows" refusal is the enforced form.
5. "`kind:'react'` executes author code in the app, so it" — still stated twice: "a react page's source is code every viewer runs" in the same sentence, now the reason after the colon, and "real React executed at render by the runtime" under the section heading. The gate `react-pages`, OFF by default, `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=true`, the disabled notice and the no-lint warning are unchanged.

Nothing else was removed; "List export has no `'pdf'` …" is only re-wrapped.

Security-touching is `yes` because hunk 3 rewrites the sentence that teaches the `react-pages` capability gate. No security proposition changed, but the hunk teaches security behaviour, so the low-risk arm does not apply.

No contradiction elsewhere: `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` carries the describe, `print-pages.mdx` says "each block of a region", and `protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` and `ui/react-pages.mdx` state the same gate.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — the kept-whole unit is a region's direct child. Two `record:details` wrapped in one `page:card` or `page:section` still move as one piece. The skill sentence does not say "of a region" (the docs table does). Not false, since the container is itself a block; accepted, optional follow-up wording.
- N2 (nit) — "sections may break between sheets" reads loosely; the ruling's phrase is "break between sections". The clause after the colon removes the doubt.
- N3 (nit) — `pages.md:231` is left unwrapped, one long line. Cosmetic.
